SYNTAX_COMMAND_WARPS:
:exclamation:Use the syntax:
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp list</color> - to show all available warps
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp points WarpName</color> - to show all teleport points for this warp
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp add WarpName</color> - to create a new warp or add an extra teleport point to it
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp edit WarpName PositionNumber</color> - to edit a teleport position for a warp
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp remove WarpName</color> - to remove a warp and all its teleport points
<color=#1F6BA0>/warp remove WarpName PositionNumber</color> - to remove a teleport position from the specified warp
